author: Guestcam Team
title: Guestcam live at the Nina Badrić concert in Maribor
description: On 18 September at 8 pm, Guestcam will collect visitors' photos at the Nina Badrić concert on the Maribox cinema terrace.
tldr: Guestcam will be at the Nina Badrić concert on the Maribox cinema terrace in Maribor on 18 September at 8 pm. Visitors share photos via QR code, and the best moments appear live on the photo wall.
coverAlt: Nina Badrić, 18 September at 8 pm, Maribox cinema terrace

content.text: Guestcam is heading to its first big public event: the Nina Badrić concert on the Maribox cinema terrace in Maribor, on 18 September at 8 pm.
How it works at the concert

items: QR codes will be around the venue; visitors scan them with their phone.
Photos and videos upload to the shared event gallery, with no app and no signup.
The best moments appear live on the photo wall.
Everything in full quality, stored in the EU.

content.text: Coming to the concert? Find the QR code at the venue and add your photos to the shared memory of the night.
